headlines.title: Hakeem Jeffries says he’s a ‘hard yes’ on impeaching Pete Hegseth
headlines.description: Jeffries said on ABC’s “This Week” that he supports Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., in his efforts to impeach Hegseth.

headlines.title: Trump says he was ‘only kidding’ about making UFC head Dana White press secretary
headlines.description: The president suggested on Truth Social that White should bring several UFC fighters as assistants.

headlines.title: Trump tells ‘60 Minutes’ his deportation policy ‘was too tough’
headlines.description: During an interview on CBS' "60 Minutes," President Trump was asked whether his deportation policies affected the midterm election outcome. Trump acknowledged that mass deportations hurt him during the midterms and expressed interest in negotiating a deal with congressional Democrats over immigration policies.

headlines.title: Nvidia opens investigation after CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy
headlines.description: Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an employee memo. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

headlines.title: Gunman with far-right views who killed 6 in Poland shooting rampage dies in hospital
headlines.description: The man who opened fire in a public square, killing six people in a suspected far-right terror attack in Kraków, Poland, has died, police said early Monday.

headlines.title: Tensions rise in Philadelphia over boycott of Jewish-owned restaurants
headlines.description: A pro-Palestinian group said it’s protesting businesses for supporting Israel. The Anti-Defamation League called it “antisemitic, plain and simple.”

headlines.title: They’re last place in their own division — and a legitimate Super Bowl contender
headlines.description: The Green Bay Packers may be at the bottom of the NFC North division, but Jordan Love has them surging toward the postseason.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: The unlikely quarterback who beat a Patrick Mahomes record
headlines.description: The Denver Broncos’ victory was their 17th consecutive win with Bo Nix as the starter in games decided by one score or less — breaking a record held by Patrick Mahomes.
